newsitem.title: USA: New York approves NYNEX connection deals.
newsitem.headline: New York approves NYNEX connection deals.

text.p: The New York Public Service Commission on Tuesday said it approved two NYNEX Corp interconnection deals, with Teleport Communications Group Inc, and WinStar Communications Inc.

These agreements, which the commission said included some modifications from the terms agreed by the companies, allow the two competitors to start selling their local telecommunication services over NYNEX's network.
NYNEX said it already has 10 resellers active in its region, with 2,500 business customers collectively. -- New York Newsroom 212 859 1610
